queryContract: Frozen outer API owns private initial velocity/contacts/floor snapshots. Per-trial RHS, active set, unload decisions, multipliers, reactions, corrections, velocity and energy remain freshly solved. Cached responses/products/projected metrics depend only on immutable geometry and exact ordered released/active layout keys.
nativeContract: Captured native methods live in the rig module. Optional ArticulatedRig.createNativeContactQuery keeps the original weapon-bind import and falls back for own/prototype overrides, duck-typed and aliased historical rigs. reactImpulse still independently validates/applies through the public default trial path.

tests.traceEquality: Complete bind/body/physics state including events, contacts, replay and mechanical fields where covered by legacy trajectory guards.

review: Independent read-only review approved ownership, geometry cache validity, ordered keys, defaults and legacy/override compatibility; no blockers.
dependencyPolicy: New reference and candidate graphs use the same current absolute dependency URLs, including cloth. Reference rig and bind are portable byte-identical 1.13 fixtures; candidate bind imports its own matching private rig class.
timingScope: No timing benchmark performed here. Retention depends on root whole-engine ABBA for D-only and cloth+D; test durations do not establish FPS or a speedup.
